reason: The coefficient reproduces (0.608, SE 0.230, N=1960) and stays near 0.60 with all pre-period covariates, but the report rests on a single observational OLS with no identification argument for why supplier diversification is exogenous, so the causal wording 'positive effect' is not supported. The bivariate estimate (2.23) falls by about 73% once controls are added, and the effect is small (about 0.05 SD of the outcome) and reported without units or magnitude, so the conclusion needs robustness checks and a clearer causal framing before release.
